children: American Barrick Gold filed a registration statement for an initial public offering of common stock, with the proposed price range and share count not yet disclosed. The company plans to list on the NYSE under the symbol ABGC and will remain controlled by parent Barrick Mining Corporation after the offering. Proceeds are expected to repay a dividend-related promissory note to Barrick, with the remainder for general corporate purposes.

American Barrick Gold is a gold producer with mining and exploration interests in Nevada and the Dominican Republic. Its main operating interests are a 61.5% controlling stake in Nevada Gold Mines, operated through a joint venture with Newmont, and a 60% controlling stake in the Pueblo Viejo mine, also operated with Newmont. The company sells gold and gold concentrate and conducts exploration and mine development.
: The filing reports global gold demand exceeded 5,000 tonnes, or approximately 161 million ounces, in 2025; it does not provide a formal addressable-market estimate.
: Global gold demand exceeded 5,000 tonnes for the first time in 2025, while central banks purchased approximately 863 tonnes.

: The company describes itself as the largest gold producer with a portfolio located entirely in North America; its Nevada Gold Mines complex was the world’s largest gold mining complex by 2025 production.
: Newmont is the company’s joint-venture partner at Nevada Gold Mines and Pueblo Viejo; the filing also references competition from other gold mining companies.

: The filing cites strong central-bank demand, geopolitical uncertainty, and gold’s role as a safe-haven and diversification asset; the average gold price was $4,545 per ounce for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.
: Attributable gold production was 2.0 million ounces in 2025 and 951,000 ounces in the six months ended June 30, 2026.
: The company reported 40 million ounces of attributable proven and probable gold reserves and 38 million ounces of attributable mineral resources as of December 31, 2025.
: The portfolio includes six large assets across Nevada and the Dominican Republic; Nevada Gold Mines accounted for 81% of attributable gold production in 2025.
: Operations and exploration interests span the United States, the Dominican Republic and Canada.
: Newmont owns the remaining 38.5% of Nevada Gold Mines and 40% of Pueblo Viejo.

: Fourmile is an exploration-stage project with indicated resources of 2.6 million ounces and inferred resources of 13 million ounces on a 100% basis; the company targets run-rate production by 2034, subject to development and permitting.

: Three customers each represented more than 10% of 2025 revenue, accounting for approximately 38%, 12% and 10%; the filing says the company is not economically dependent on a limited number of customers for gold sales.
: $7.259 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026
: Increased 61% compared with the six months ended June 30, 2025
: $4.379 billion, calculated as revenue less cost of sales, for the six months ended June 30, 2026 (60.3% margin)
: $3.225 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026; $1.765 billion attributable to owners
, President and Chief Executive Officer - Mining executive with 30 years of experience; previously served as Barrick’s president and CEO and held senior operating and strategy roles.

, Chief Operating Officer - Mining and operations leader with more than 15 years of experience across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa; previously held senior roles at Barrick, MMG and Rio Tinto.
, Chief Financial Officer - Mining-sector finance executive who held senior finance roles at Barrick and Glencore; a Chartered Accountant.
, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary - Legal, governance and regulatory executive with more than 20 years of experience, including senior roles at Barrick and Dana Incorporated.
, Chief Technical Officer - Mining and processing leader with more than 20 years of experience; previously led operations at Cortez and Pueblo Viejo.
, Chief Development Officer - Previously held senior strategy and development roles at Barrick and has experience in accounting, treasury and capital allocation.
, Director and Chairman - Mining and energy executive with more than 40 years of industry experience and prior board and executive leadership roles.
: Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, BofA Securities, Citigroup and RBC Capital Markets
: Repay the promissory note issued to Barrick as a dividend immediately before the offering; use remaining proceeds for general corporate purposes.
